Flexee

A flexible jobs app for students and part-time workers, focused on trustworthy shift discovery, availability matching, and low-friction applications.

Focus areas

Solution preview

Flexee is a flexible jobs app designed for students and part-time workers who need fast, trustworthy and manageable shift opportunities. The product focuses on clear job information, availability-based matching, profile verification and a simple application flow to reduce stress and decision overload.
